entities.summary: Victoria Movsessian-Lamoriello is an American ice hockey player. She won a gold medal at the 1998 Winter Olympics. She was the founder of the Massachusetts Spitfires and Rhode Island Sting girls hockey clubs. Movsessian was born in Concord, Massachusetts, but grew up in Lexington, Massachusetts.
